edition_angle: Uncovering targeted physiological mechanisms: from sugar-protein interactions in neurodegeneration clearance to structural balance dynamics in older adults.

assignments.angle: Neuronal heparan sulfate sulfation acts as a molecular gatekeeper regulating the pathological uptake and glymphatic clearance of alpha-synuclein aggregates.
assignments.reason: This primary preprint provides a concrete biochemical and physiological mechanism demonstrating how modifying heparan sulfate chain sulfation directly impacts pathogenic protein internalization, glymphatic clearance, and downstream neurodegeneration.
